a: RANK() assigns ranks with gaps after ties.
DENSE_RANK() ranks without gaps after ties.
ROW_NUMBER() assigns unique sequential numbers per partition.
LAG/LEAD access previous/next row values in a window.
Recursive CTEs can walk hierarchies like org charts.
Isolation levels control visibility of concurrent changes.
ANALYZE updates planner statistics for better plans.
Partial indexes cover only rows matching a condition.
A covering index can satisfy a query without table lookups.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE runs the query and shows actual timings.
